location_description: Carlsbad is a coastal city in the North County region of San Diego County, California, United States.  The city is 87 miles (140 km) south of downtown Los Angeles and 35 miles (56 km) north of downtown San Diego.  As of the 2020 census, the population of the city was 114,746.
